deleteAccount.subtitle: Why you are leaving
deleteAccount.intro: Select the main reason you wish to delete your account.
reasons: I no longer use the app
I'm not satisfied with the service
I have privacy or security concerns
I want to stop trading / using financial features
I want to create a new account
deleteAccount.verifyIntro: Connect Telegram to receive the verification code. Then enter the code and your password, and choose whether to delete now or schedule deletion after a 7-day grace period.
deleteAccount.confirmationBody: Immediate deletion revokes access right away. You can also schedule deletion after a 7-day grace period, during which the account stays read-only. Personal identifiers such as your phone number and email are anonymized, while trading, billing, and audit records may be retained where required for compliance, fraud prevention, and operational integrity.
deleteAccount.retentionBody: Deleting your account removes access and anonymizes direct identifiers such as your phone number, email, and profile details. We retain only the minimum trading, billing, and audit records required for legal, compliance, fraud-prevention, dispute-handling, and operational purposes.

items.question: How do I connect MT4/MT5 accounts?
items.answer: Visit the Channels tab and use the Add Server workflow. Once connected, orders sync automatically with your automation rules.

items.question: What payment methods are supported?
items.answer: We currently support Confirmo crypto payments. You can manage your plan inside the Pricing or Profile > My Plan sections.

items.question: How can I change my automation preferences?
items.answer: Use the Notifications page under Profile > Settings to toggle each alert type and keep the app updated with your preferences.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Tragram uses JWT authentication, OTP flows, and Confirmo for payment operations. The Security section summarizes your session data.
